exposure: gestational age at time of sterilisation
time interval from post tubal ligation to conception
experience of the surgeon (junior resident/years of experience)
cohort: The study included 528 women who reported or were referred as tubal sterilisation failure to family welfare departments at two tertiary care hospitals in India over a 10-year period (2011-2020).
finding: The overall prevalence rate of female sterilisation failure was 1.8% over 10 years, with the majority of failures presenting as intrauterine pregnancies (57%) and occurring between 1-5 years post-sterilization.
